description: Ask the human to do something with your mail, documents or parcels. scan = open + scan (included; same_day: true = today, +2 €). forward = 3 € (letter) / 5 € (parcel) handling + postage (express: +5 €). return. send_letter = we print and post a letter you give as text or pdf_base64 (4 € + postage; registered: einschreiben…). ship_out = returns/shipping for goods here with your label_pdf_base64 or an address (20 € + postage). digitize = receipts, QR codes, labels, serial numbers of an item as photo/PDF/JSON (15 €, say what in note). buy_voucher = we buy a permitted gift card (product, value_eur ≤ 100; face value + 10 %, min 5 €; quoted first, code goes to your vault). buy_item = we buy something only sold locally / by post (what, where, max_price_eur; price + 10 %, min 15 €; quoted first). courier, dispose, custom. Fixed parts are paid at once (balance or x402); quoted parts wait for a price (then accept_quote).

api_key.description: Your hm_... key. Only needed if your MCP client cannot send the "Authorization: Bearer" header.

express.description: forward only: dispatch the same day (+5 €).

label_pdf_base64.description: ship_out: a prepaid shipping / return label as PDF, base64.

max_postage_eur.description: forward/return: postage up to this amount is charged automatically.

max_price_eur.description: buy_item: the most the item itself may cost (max 500).

pdf_base64.description: send_letter: the letter as an A4 PDF, base64 (max 5 MB, b/w, up to 10 pages).

same_day.description: scan only: open + scan today (+2 € or 1 same-day credit).

sender.description: Optional return address printed on the forwarded item. Must be you/your operator or their company.

shipment_id.description: Pre-book for an announced shipment that has not arrived yet.

text.description: send_letter: the letter as plain text (printed as is).

where.description: buy_item: shop or place, if known.

name: request_action
title: Order an action
